right_anchored_formula: R = direct target PR35 R; L = R + (geometry L - geometry R). Direct target L never enters either contextual estimator.
availability: Donors need both model endpoints with confidence >= 0.50, finite coordinates and the half-open image bounds. confidence: Direct points retain their original model confidences. Context-derived points have no calibrated confidence and do not inherit a donor confidence.

limits: Manual stack/rank and frozen reference-box matching remain oracle-assisted. Reference boxes are never geometry inputs.
